label: preserve
contract: The result has one count for every bin, len(edges) - 1 in all, and a bin that receives no values counts 0.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([], [0, 10, 20], [0, 0]), ([15], [0, 10, 20], [0, 1]), ([2.5, 1], [0, 3, 6, 9], [2, 0, 0])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([], [0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 0, 0]), ([7, 8], [0, 5, 10, 15], [0, 2, 0]), ([0.5], [0, 2, 4], [1, 0])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)

label: inferable
contract: Bins can have different widths, and each value is counted in the bin given by the actual edges.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([0.5, 1.5, 4, 9], [0, 1, 2, 10], [1, 1, 2]), ([0.5, 3, 5.5, 2], [0, 1, 5, 6], [1, 2, 1])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([1, 3, 3, 50], [0, 2, 10, 100], [1, 2, 1]), ([1, 4.5, 6, 7], [0, 4, 5, 8], [1, 1, 2])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)

label: preserve
contract: A value equal to an edge between two bins is counted in the bin that starts at that edge.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([10, 5, 15], [0, 10, 20], [1, 2]), ([3, 6, 1, 4, 8], [0, 3, 6, 9], [1, 2, 2])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([5, 2, 7], [0, 5, 10], [1, 2]), ([4, 8, 1, 5, 11], [0, 4, 8, 12], [1, 2, 2])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)

label: inferable
contract: A value equal to the first edge is counted in the first bin.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([0, 12, 3], [0, 10, 20], [2, 1]), ([-2.5, 0, -1], [-2.5, -0.5, 1.5], [2, 1])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([1, 2, 7], [1, 5, 9], [2, 1]), ([0.5, 0.75], [0.5, 0.7, 0.9], [1, 1])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: A value equal to the last edge is counted in the last bin.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([20, 5, 11], [0, 10, 20], [1, 2]), ([4, 1.5, 3.5], [1, 2.5, 4], [1, 2])):
    got = histogram(values, edges)
    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
for values, edges, want in (([10, 6, 2], [0, 5, 10], [1, 2]), ([0.9, 0.1, 0.6], [0.0, 0.5, 0.9], [1, 2])):

    assert got == want, (values, edges, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: A value below the first edge or above the last edge raises ValueError.
